card.name: Adjective endings in medical terms
card.fires_on: The ending of an adjective split off from its stem, mostly 'atic' after 'Hep' or 'hep' (hepatic). Also 'eric' in telomeric, 'tic' in macrocytic and 'ern' in southeastern.

modes.label: Hepatic ending
modes.description: The 'atic' ending after 'Hep' or 'hep' in liver-related warnings and pharmacology text.

card.writes: It seems to suppress noun-forming endings such as 'ities' and 'ity', since an adjective ending is complete at this point.
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a split-up adjective, most often 'hepatic' meaning liver-related.
